providers.region_verification: The resource endpoint uses a custom subdomain that does not encode the region. Confirmed two ways on 2026-08-03: the account owner states the resource was created in East US, and the public CNAME chain for medora-prescription-ocr-ai.cognitiveservices.azure.com terminates in eastus-01.azure-api.net and eastus.cloudapp.azure.com.
providers.fallback_policy: none during benchmark; immutable response cache
providers.retention_assumption: Microsoft states input and analysis results are encrypted and stored temporarily in the resource region for 24 hours; Delete Analyze Result can purge results earlier

providers.region: United States for retained customer data (Groq-documented GCP buckets)
providers.fallback_policy: Live results reported per provider; never pooled
providers.retention_assumption: Groq exposes no API for the organization Zero Data Retention setting, so this release makes the conservative assumption instead of a favourable claim: synchronous inference is not retained by default, and inputs and outputs may be logged for up to 30 days for reliability and abuse handling per Groq's published policy. No Zero Data Retention agreement is claimed for this deployment.
providers.retention_verification: Checked 2026-08-08. The GroqCloud REST API has no organization-settings endpoint; the ZDR flag is visible only in the console. The documented default above is therefore treated as the operative retention.

providers.provider: Vapi with OpenAI, Deepgram, and Vapi voice components
providers.region: United States transfer disclosed by Vapi; downstream component regions are provider-managed
providers.fallback_policy: none; local audio mode is a separate workflow
providers.retention_assumption: Vapi's documented pay-as-you-go retention applies: up to 14 days for calls and 30 days for chats. All three assistants on the account return compliancePlan null and artifactPlan null, so no assistant-scope compliance or artifact override reduces it. No Zero Data Retention agreement is claimed for this deployment.
providers.retention_verification: Checked 2026-08-08 against the live account. GET /assistant with the private key returns HTTP 200 and three assistants, each with compliancePlan and artifactPlan null. GET /org, GET /org/{id}, and GET /org/me all return HTTP 401 for both the private and public keys, so the organization-scope retention flag is readable only in the console; the documented default above is treated as the operative retention.
